title: Netflix Global Content Strategy & Business Insights Report
task_name: Task 6: Data Science Business Insights Dashboard
author: Rishi Prajapati
executive_summary: This capstone project synthesizes end-to-end data analytics, machine learning classification, recommendation intelligence, and statistical forecasting into a strategic decision-making dashboard. Key strategic imperatives focus on increasing multi-season serial productions, expanding localized Asian and Latin American episodic content, and implementing family-oriented ad-tier monetization.

strategic_pillars.observation: Movies comprise 69.7% of catalog, but TV shows offer significantly higher viewer retention & lifetime subscriber value.
strategic_pillars.action: Increase multi-season TV show commissions to 40% of annual budget to reduce subscriber churn.

strategic_pillars.observation: India has 1,057 titles with 92.3% movie concentration; US library is mature.
strategic_pillars.action: Produce localized serialized regional series in emerging markets (India, Latin America) where series penetration is under-indexed.

strategic_pillars.observation: Adult-rated titles represent 45.6% of library; Family/Kids titles account for 21.6%.
strategic_pillars.action: Introduce tiered ad-supported family bundles to monetize the underserved Under-14 age demographic.

strategic_pillars.observation: 28.4% of content is added on Fridays, causing internal competition among new releases.
strategic_pillars.action: Adopt staggered releases (mid-week drops on Wednesdays for niche documentaries/indies) to maximize viewer attention.
